title: Seventy-one years: 23 July 2026
author: Editorial Desk
summary: The Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh enters its seventy-second year.
body:
On **23 July 2026**, BMS completed 71 years. The anniversary came days after it hosted the BRICS Trade Union Forum in Hyderabad.

## Three scenes from seventy-one years

- **1955:** a small meeting at Bhopal, with no union affiliated.
- **Late 1980s:** a membership claimed in the tens of lakhs, and recognition as the largest central trade union.
- **2026:** hosting an international forum in India and engaging ministers on the Labour Codes, the unorganised sector and scheme workers.

## What has stayed the same

The motto, the principle of constructive trade unionism, and the working style of karyakartas who give time and sustain the union from their own pockets.

## What has changed

Workers now work through apps and platforms. Factories have fewer permanent workers. Women and young people form a larger share of the labour force. Unions must organise differently.

## The challenge

A movement of seventy years has a history to be proud of and a future to earn. As Thengadi Ji would say, the real measure is the worker at the bottom of the pyramid.
